item.title: Delhi reports 138 fresh H1N1 cases in 24 hours; tally crosses 2,400
item.summary: Delhi recorded 138 new H1N1 cases in twenty-four hours, bringing the total to 2,446. Health officials reviewed hospital preparedness for influenza and other respiratory illnesses. Hospitals were directed to strengthen emergency services and ensure adequate isolation beds. The Delhi Medical Association advised mask-wearing and avoiding self-medication for flu symptoms. Authorities are monitoring trends and hospital readiness to manage patient care effectively.
